text:
leah_partnerships: Heads-up: partners are asking for a firm marketplace freeze for B200 + H200 next Friday. We need lab + SI signoffs, plus comms alignment. Can we surface blockers now?

ash_vendor_pm: H200 BIOS candidate is in internal CI; we can cut a partner build Thu EOD. B200 vendor recommends a new fan curve to hit performance targets; they provided suggested config. Gaudi driver backport is in review.

.tom_infra: Quick status: B200 fan-curve rerun shows ~6% perf delta, but stable. H200 thermal test will need the BIOS candidate to be meaningful. Gaudi image still on kernel 5.15 in our fleet; backport test needed. MI300 long-context nightly flaky (OOMs) on quantized path.

nina_si: SI capacity: Tue/Wed morning available for connector + interoperability runs. We need artifacts (BIOS, drivers, kernel patches) by Mon EOD to keep schedule. If artifacts miss Mon, SI can do a partial cert for H100/B200 only.

rachel_comms: From comms POV, we should avoid announcing H200 or Gaudi in the marketplace copy unless they are SI-certified. Proposal: publish H100+B200 on lead GA, mark H200/MI300/Gaudi as "validating" with expected follow-on GA in 7 days. Keeps partner press simple.

leah_partnerships: Action items: (1) Ash to drop timestamped artifacts to the partner bucket by Mon EOD; (2) Tom to schedule lab reruns Tue 06:00-09:00 UTC for fan/thermal and push images; (3) Nina to reserve Tue/Wed SI slots; (4) Rachel to draft conditional marketplace blurb that flags "pending" devices. Please paste S3 links and hashes here.

ash_vendor_pm: Will upload BIOS + driver backport to s3://partners/redwood/h200/1733333333/ by 2024-04-10T17:00:00Z and share sha256. Also adding recommended B200 fan-profile file.

deploy-bot: Image tag gaudi-k6-backport-2024 deployed to staging at 2024-04-09T06:45:00Z; smoke tests queued.

tom_infra: Reruns scheduled Tue 06:30-08:30 UTC. I will post logs and perf diffs here after runs.

nina_si: SI slots reserved Tue 07:00 UTC and Wed 07:00 UTC. If artifacts miss Mon, we will certify H100+B200 baseline and mark H200/MI300/Gaudi "pending" in the portal.

rachel_comms: Draft blurb ready: "Initial GA includes H100 and B200 (certified). H200, MI300, and Gaudi are under validation and will be added after completion of partner-driven SI tests." I will not publish until we confirm SI green.

leah_partnerships: Thanks. Keep all artifact links and firmware hashes in this thread. If vendors provide embargo windows or press constraints, paste them here immediately. :spiral_calendar:
